rationale: Zelensky's public defense of Crimean Bridge strikes signals continued strategic offensive; Russian missile strike on Lviv hits western Ukraine near NATO borders; Baltic drone attack shows operational reach.

top_events.title: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting
top_events.label: Zelensky defends Crimean Bridge strikes UK
top_events.summary: President publicly justifies strategic strikes on Russian infrastructure after 109 Russian attacks on Ukrainian bridges, signaling continued offensive operations and international diplomatic support.

top_events.title: Dashcam captures Russian missile strike on Lviv, Ukraine
top_events.label: Russian missile strikes Lviv residential area
top_events.summary: Missile attack hits western Ukrainian city's residential neighborhood, extending Russian strikes beyond eastern front and threatening civilian infrastructure near NATO borders.

top_events.title: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland
top_events.label: Ukraine strikes Russia-bound ship Finland
top_events.summary: Ukrainian drone successfully attacks Russian cargo vessel in Baltic waters, demonstrating extended operational reach beyond Black Sea theater.

most_significant_event.label: Russian double-tap strike kills 72 rescuers
most_significant_event.summary: Russia deliberately targets rescue workers with follow-up strikes in southern Ukraine, killing 72 and hampering body recovery. Intensified attacks on civilian responders.
